title: European Motorcars
description: european-motorcars.com European Motorcars is a multi-brand premium European car dealership founded in 1972 in Dayton, Ohio, with 54 years of experience selling and servicing Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo and MINI. With 50 to 100 employees across two locations on Miamisburg-Centerville Road and Dorothy Lane in Kettering, it offers new and certified pre-owned vehicles, official service centers with brand-specific diagnostic equipment and an in-house body shop. The dealership provides full-cycle services including financing, insurance, trade-in and professional detailing. It stands out as one of the few multi-brand premium European dealers in the region, allowing customers to compare and service multiple brands under one roof. Key strengths are 54 years of local trust, certified technician teams for each brand and original parts inventory. It serves the greater Dayton metropolitan area of approximately 800,000 people.
